1.
The appeal is filed by the insurer challenging the compensation of Rs.6,99,300/- awarded for the injuries sustained by the claimant.
2. The liability for payment of the compensation is not in dispute.
However, it is sought to be contended that the monthly income assessed and the percentage of disability assessed is on the higher side.
opennyai_summary.facts:
The Tribunal has relied NC: 2024:KHC-K:6849 upon the chart prepared by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority for assessing the income at Rs.14,750/- and on the basis of the evidence of the treated doctor, it has assessed disability at 16%.
In my view, in the light of the fact that the compensation is based on the chart prepared by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority and the evidence of the treated doctor, there is no justification for interfering with the award of the Labour court.
